Math.mulDiv(uint256,uint256,uint256) (lib/openzeppelin-contracts/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol#123-202) has bitwise-xor operator ^ instead of the exponentiation operator **: 
	 - inverse = (3 * denominator) ^ 2 (lib/openzeppelin-contracts/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol#184)

Reentrancy in BMCStaking._sendBMC(address,uint256,uint256) (src/BMCStaking.sol#595-611):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- BMC.safeTransfer(recipient,amount) (src/BMCStaking.sol#601)
	Balance read before the call:
	- beforeRecipient = BMC.balanceOf(recipient) (src/BMCStaking.sol#600)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- afterBalance > beforeBalance || beforeBalance - afterBalance != amount || afterRecipient < beforeRecipient || afterRecipient - beforeRecipient > amount (src/BMCStaking.sol#605-606)
		- stale variable `beforeRecipient`
	- received < minReceived (src/BMCStaking.sol#610)
		- stale variable `received`

Reentrancy in BMCStaking._receiveBMC(uint256,uint256) (src/BMCStaking.sol#583-593):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- BMC.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender,address(this),amount) (src/BMCStaking.sol#586)
	Balance read before the call:
	- beforeBalance = BMC.balanceOf(address(this)) (src/BMCStaking.sol#585)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- afterBalance <= beforeBalance || afterBalance - beforeBalance > amount (src/BMCStaking.sol#588)
		- stale variable `beforeBalance`
	- received < minReceived (src/BMCStaking.sol#592)
		- stale variable `received`
